# ANALYSIS: STAGE1_BASELINE_BACKTEST

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need to establish the baseline performance of the current engine (as of the latest params) in terms of edge_capture on J's anchor days and wide_pnl over the full backtest period. This will serve as the reference point for evaluating future strategy candidates.

## Mechanism

Run the autoresearch grinder harness in Stage-1 mode over the full historical OPRA dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using the current engine configuration (params.json as of latest commit). Compute edge_capture as defined in OP-16 (sum of engine P&L on J winner days minus sum of max(0, engine loss on J loser days)). Compute wide_pnl as total P&L over the entire period.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The backtest uses the default qty from params.json, which assumes a $25K+ account for full size; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** The sample includes all trades generated by the current engine over the full 16-month OPRA window (approx 345 trading days). Selection is deterministic based on engine signals; overfit risk is low as we are measuring baseline, not optimizing.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (this Stage-1 backtest is in-sample; OOS validation would require a walk-forward split).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (the backtest uses the grinder harness which currently uses BS simulator; real-fills validation requires OPRA cache).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day would be the largest single-day loss; max drawdown from equity curve; blow-up scenario if consecutive losses exceed daily risk limit.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, we will compute after backtest.
